nodes.title: Land the card
nodes.instructions: Follow the card-refine skill, section 2 LANDS, for the ClickUp card named in the request: fetch the task and its comments, save task.json and comments.json under ~/.cache/card-pipeline/cards/<card-id>/, run land.ts, open every shot. Report pass with the card folder path as evidence. Write nothing to ClickUp.

nodes.title: Project manager: investigate, decide, draft
nodes.instructions: Run the project-manager agent (Agent tool, subagent_type: project-manager) with --card <the card folder from the lands evidence> --examples ~/.claude/skills/card-refine/examples --registry ~/.claude/skills/card-refine/scripts/repo-registry.json --architect ~/.claude/agents/code-architect.md. When prod.md exists in the card folder, tell the agent to use it. Return the agent's package.md verbatim. Pass when every section of the output block is present (VERDICT, CONFIDENCE, CHECKS, RULES, PROJECT, SYSTEM, SPRINT, ESTIMATE, COMMENT, SUBTASKS, REPORT, PROD-QUESTIONS, LINT). Blocked only on a tool or script error; name it. Do not write to ClickUp, code or production.

nodes.title: Production lookups
nodes.instructions: Follow the card-refine skill, section 4 PROD-LOOKUPS. PROD-QUESTIONS is none: pass with evidence "no production questions". Otherwise run the production-investigator agent on prod-questions.md and the card folder, let it write prod.md, and report fail with summary "new facts in prod.md" so the project-manager runs again.

nodes.title: Refinement advisor (cross-family)
nodes.instructions: Read card.md, facts.md and the project-manager package (package.md) in the card folder from the upstream evidence. Check only this hard-fail list: a number, price, policy or formula with no source in the card, the owner's words or the code; a numbered item dropped or disposed twice; a question the code or a screenshot answers; a question about priority or urgency; a [label] not in the repo registry; requested scope marked ไม่ต้องทำ without proof it exists or was not asked; ต้นเหตุ not supported by the cited evidence; a proposed subtask that is only a repository, a layer or a dev note rather than one independently useful business outcome; a subtask with no Fibonacci hour estimate. Output at most 5 findings, each with its evidence, or the single line "no findings". One pass, no loop, no rewriting. Always end pass; evidence = the findings or 'no findings'.

nodes.title: Owner approves
nodes.instructions: Follow the card-refine skill, section 5 APPROVE: show the owner the one approval screen (verdict, confidence, the comment as it would be posted, subtasks with hours and sprint, the refinement-advisor findings, the lint output, the package path) and take yes, edit, or send back with a note. Save an edit or a send-back to the examples before anything else. Pass only on the owner's yes, with the approved comment as evidence.

nodes.title: Send to ClickUp and read back
nodes.instructions: Follow the card-refine skill, section 6 SEND, for the approved card: post or replace our comment, create or update only proposed subtasks that each have one independently useful business outcome and a Fibonacci hour estimate, do not delete existing subtasks the package does not list, clear the parent estimate only when those children were written, then set Planning to the latest AI sprint on the card and every subtask, and read everything back. Report pass with the readback as evidence; report what did not save.
